 Kernel advanced editor

 Hostname editor

fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.name: Ratafuel
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.summary: Find the cheapest fuel in France near you.
fdroid:com.juliencardoux.ratafuel.description:
Ratafuel help you find the cheapest fuel in France near your.
Fuel price data in France is public, free, and legally mandatory. However, most applications are saturated with ads and trackers at the expense of privacy and accessibility. Access to information is a fundamental right and should not be traded for your privacy.
 Ratafuel is a 100% free, open-source application with absolutely zero trackers, zero ads and built to respect user freedom. 
 FEATURES 
- Displays current prices and locations of gas stations throughout France
- Quickly identify the cheapest stations using a color code
- Filter price based on preferred fuel type
- Filter gas stations based on retailer brand
- Search for a specific city without needing to enable device location
- Navigate to the selected station using any navigation app
- View and access all public open-data sources with full transparency
- Customize the app appearance and settings
- Support French & English
- Privacy first: no tracking, no ads, zero data collection and fully open-source
- Simple and straight to the point app
 PERMISSIONS 
Location permissions (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) are used exclusively to show your position locally within the app. Location permissions are optional and can be enabled or disabled by the user at any time, the app will function perfectly without them.
 SETUP 
1. Launch the application once downloaded.
2. Choose whether or not to use your device's location to find the cheapest price near you.
3. Choose whether or not to enable Automatic Updates. If enabled, the station data will be updated every week at startup.
4. Click the Download button to download stations data locally.
5. You can customize the app in the Parameters section or simply use it as is!
 PRIVACY 
Ratafuel collects no data. There are no analytics, no ads, no trackers. As stated above, location permissions are used exclusively to show your position locally within the app. No location data is ever collected, stored, or shared.
 GOVERNMENT LIMITATIONS 
The publication of fuel prices is a legal obligation for fuel distributors, as required by Articles 5 and 6 of the Ministerial Order of 8 July 1988 ¹ .
The Département d'outre-mer are unfortunately not displayed within Ratafuel due to uncomprehensible missing data from the Fuel Price French Government API.
In the DOM, fuel prices are regulated every month by prefects setting a maximum price via prefectural decrees, in accordance with Articles R671-1 to R671-31 of the French Energy Code ² .
Without any further justification and without any apparent technical problem, these data are not added to the public database of fuel prices.
Under Article 73 of the Constitution ³ , regulations are applicable as of right in these departments, unless expressly derogated. No identifiable derogating provision seems to exclude the DOM from this publication.
Due to a lack of reliable data, the DOM are unfortunately not supported for now.
 NOTES 
- ¹ https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/id/JORFTEXT000000688923/
- ² https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/codes/section_lc/LEGITEXT000023983208/LEGISCTA000031749957/
- ³ https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/loda/article_lc/LEGIARTI000019241099

 FiSSH for Linux is available on GitLab together with install instructions at: https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-desktop/blob/master/INSTALL.md .
 FiSSH for Windows uses the Windows Subsystem for Linux. The Windows edition is also open source and published to: https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-windows .
To install FiSSH for Windows run the command inside WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) UBUNTU distro:
 curl https://www.gitlab.com/ioanm/fissh-windows/raw/master/Release/install.sh | sudo bash 
The PC app then returns the received passphrase to OpenSSH and the standard ssh binary completes the login process.
It is important to note that none of the FiSSH apps have access to private key file and that FiSSH uses TLS sockets with certificate validation to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks!

firefox-addons:586652.name: Rename Tab Title
firefox-addons:586652.summary:
Renames the Tab Title (Persistent across the sessions).
Renaming to add custom words in tab titles makes it easy to search for tabs in the address bar.
firefox-addons:586652.description:
Renames the Tab Title (Firefox 52+)
Click the icon on the ToolBar (or) use the shortcut Cmd/Ctrl + Shift+ E (instructions to customize are mentioned at bottom)
You'll get a popup, enter the new title
a)Click on Save (or) Press Enter to Save or Esc to close the popup without saving title
(closing the Popup without saving makes the title non persistent)
---
b) Click on "Edit All" in the popup to manage saved titles or use regex feature
In Urls section, select the URL from dropdown located at the bottom of the page
Edit the Title in textbox
Click on save (or) Press Enter to save the title.
Click on delete to delete the title.
In Regex section, add/update regex and the corresponding title and press "Save"
eg: /.*google.*/ matches all the websites which has the term google in the url,
 /*/ matches all websites
*some websites keeps updating the title on some events (eg: gmail.com updates title whenever hangouts gets initialized and whenever someone pings) this addon doesn't work in such cases as i didn't add the polling. If have any workaround for this please do mention in the comments.. thanks
If you have any suggestion for shortcut.
Please mention it in the comments and the reason why it is better.
customizing shortcut 
- for version 68+
1. Go to about:addons
2. Click on setting's icon -> Manage extension shortcuts. Scroll to Rename Tab Title and customize

firefox-addons:778813.name: Dark New Tab
firefox-addons:778813.summary: Open a blank dark or white tab rather than the default browser's new tab page.
firefox-addons:778813.description:
Dark New Tab , is a simple and very lite addon which enables you to open a new tab, completely empty with just a dark or white background color. The default browser tab is usually packed with lots of items such as tiles, bookmarks, search filed, etc. If you prefer to have a simple and clean new tab, this add-on works just great for you. Simply add it to your browser and it works instantly. 
Note: the default background color is dark. If you prefer a white background color please press on the - moon - icon at the top left corner of the screen. This toggle button will switch the background color, and stores the state in the memory.
How to work with this addon: just click on the new tab button on your browser and it opens a blank tab instead of the default one.
If you have a feature request or found a bug to report, please fill the bug report form in the add-on's homepage .
